live.instructions:
RepSpec specifies architectural lighting + electrical from real manufacturer catalogs (~355 makers, grounded to real SKUs).

HOW TO USE
• Describe a space to `spec_building` for a full fixture/controls spec + BOM, or use `search_products`, `get_product_details`, and `cross_reference`. By DEFAULT everything runs on the GENERAL PLATFORM — the whole catalog, ALL manufacturers.
• Scope to one maker: call `connect_manufacturer` (e.g. "aleo"), then pass `scope:"aleo"` to `spec_building` to spec only their lines. `list_connections` shows the user's available scopes (general, their connected manufacturers, and any covering rep firm); `disconnect_manufacturer` removes one.
• Identify the user with `set_account_type` (designer / specifier / rep / manufacturer / contractor).

ADDING CONNECTIONS
• Manufacturers are self-serve: `connect_manufacturer`. To work under a REP firm's line card, the user connects through that rep's portal or their invite link (reps aren't self-added from here).

CREDITS
• New accounts get 5 free credits; runs cost credits (a spec ≈ 2, a cross ≈ 1), drawn from the user's balance — or a manufacturer's sponsored pool when connected on that maker's portal. Buy more at repspec.app/credits.

All outputs are preliminary planning estimates — a licensed professional must review before use.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search RepSpec lighting product catalog (29,000+ products, 355 manufacturers). API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

query.description: Search query — product name, type, or catalog number

manufacturer.description: Filter by manufacturer code: ILC, WS, GENLYTE, ACUITY, CK, ETC, etc.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get details for a specific product by catalog number. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: list_manufacturers
tools.description: List all manufacturers in RepSpec. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: getting_started
tools.description: Show a short guide on how to use RepSpec here — what it does, how to spec, how to scope to a manufacturer you add, and how credits work. Call this when the user asks how to get started, what they can do, or how it works.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Show which scopes this account can spec with: the GENERAL PLATFORM (the whole catalog — ALL ~355 manufacturers, the default for every tool), the manufacturers this account has connected to (scoped to that maker's lines, run on the maker's sponsored credits where funded), and the rep firm covering this account (if any). Call this to see the options before spec'ing. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: spec_building
tools.description: Generate a constraint-checked lighting + controls specification (bill of materials) for a space. Enforces the engineering floor (protocol compatibility, one controls system per project). By DEFAULT it uses the GENERAL PLATFORM — the whole catalog, ALL ~355 manufacturers. Set `scope` to a manufacturer you've connected to (e.g. 'aleo') to spec only that maker's lines (and run on their sponsored credits), or to your rep firm to use their book. Requires a signed-in RepSpec account. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

description.description: The space + intent, e.g. 'a 24-room hotel corridor, warm dimming, WattStopper controls'

scope.description: 'general' (default — all ~355 manufacturers), or a manufacturer/rep you're connected to (e.g. 'aleo') to scope to their lines. Use list_connections to see your options.

tools.name: cross_reference
tools.description: Cross a competitor fixture to the equivalent product in YOUR rep firm's lines (the crossing tool). Requires a signed-in account tied to a rep firm — a rep crosses their own book, a specifier crosses their linked rep's book. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

competitor_product.description: The competitor fixture — manufacturer + catalog #, e.g. 'Lithonia BLT 2x4' or 'Cooper WaveLinx'

tools.name: set_account_type
tools.description: Set what kind of user this account is: 'designer', 'specifier', 'rep', 'manufacturer', or 'contractor'. Captured on the account so tools and portals present the right experience. (A rep-firm membership always takes precedence as the ground truth.) API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: connect_manufacturer
tools.description: Connect this account to a manufacturer (e.g. 'aleo') so its scoped tools are available and (on that maker's web portal) runs can draw from the maker's sponsored credits. Consent-based and revocable with disconnect_manufacturer. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: disconnect_manufacturer
tools.description: Disconnect this account from a manufacturer (going forward). API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: skylight_spec
tools.description: SKYLIGHTS vertical. Describe a room and ceiling (room type, approximate floor area, ceiling type — flat-with-attic / vaulted / flat-deep-plenum, existing light level, roof type, fresh-air wanted) and get a VELUX skylight specification: which units and published sizes, quantity, flashing, rough openings, an install outline, and a budgetary range. Set `scope` to a skylights contractor you've connected to (e.g. 'skylightpros') to spec their way and land the lead in their inbox. Requires a signed-in RepSpec account. API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

description.description: The room + ceiling in plain language, e.g. 'dark 200 sqft kitchen, flat ceiling with attic above, asphalt shingle roof, want fresh air'

scope.description: 'general' (default), or a skylights contractor you're connected to (e.g. 'skylightpros') to use their spec rules and send them the lead.

tools.name: connect_firm
tools.description: Request a connection to a rep firm or contractor SUBDOMAIN (e.g. 'sci', 'psa', 'skylightpros') so you can use THEIR externally-available tools scoped to their lines — spec'ing on their catalog, and (for a subscribed firm) on their credits. This sends a request the firm's admin approves; until approved it's PENDING. Use list_connections to see status and which vertical/tools each unlocks. (Manufacturers use connect_manufacturer, which is instant.) API docs: https://repspec.app/mcp

tools.name: ck_search
tools.description: Search the Color Kinetics store catalog (the products MC Connected — an Authorized Color Kinetics Reseller — sells at MSRP). Returns catalog numbers, names, MSRP and family. Use this to find valid CK SKUs before sizing a system or building an order.

query.description: Product search, e.g. 'reachelite rgbw', 'graze elite 4ft', 'vaya linear'

tools.name: ck_size_system
tools.description: Size a complete Color Kinetics system for a fixture FAMILY and quantity — the engine adds the right power/data supplies, cabling and (if needed) a Pharos controller, and returns the priced BOM at MSRP. Families: FlexElite, ReachElite, Graze Elite, Graze Compact PowerCore, ColorGraze IntelliHue PowerCore, PureStyle, Vaya Linear, Vaya, Blast Elite, eW Burst.

fixture_code.description: Optional specific fixture catalog # within the family

tools.name: ck_order
tools.description: Prepare a Color Kinetics purchase through MC Connected (Authorized Reseller). Give the line items (catalog # + qty); it recomputes MSRP from the store, totals the order, and returns a secure checkout link with the cart pre-loaded. The buyer opens the link, signs into their account (required), and pays: CREDIT CARD for orders under $2,500, or a PURCHASE ORDER at $2,500 and above (MC Connected reviews + invoices). Payment always completes in the browser.

fixture_only.description: Default false. When false, each fixture is auto-expanded into a complete installable system (Data Enabler, cabling, controller). Set true ONLY to order bare fixtures with no infrastructure.
